business.name: Cedar Park Dental
business.tagline: Gentle dentistry for the whole family.
business.description: A general and cosmetic dental practice in Cedar Park, accepting most PPO plans. We schedule generous appointment windows so nobody gets rushed through a cleaning.

contact.address: 902 Whitestone Blvd, Suite 210, Cedar Park, TX 78613

services.name: Cleanings & Exams
services.description: Routine hygiene visits with digital X-rays and an oral cancer screening.

services.name: Fillings & Crowns
services.description: Tooth-colored composite fillings and same-day crowns milled in office.

services.name: Teeth Whitening
services.description: In-chair whitening in a single visit, or custom take-home trays.

services.name: Clear Aligners
services.description: Full treatment planning with monthly check-ins until you are done.

services.name: Emergency Visits
services.description: Same-day appointments for pain, swelling, or a broken tooth.

about.story: Dr. Nguyen opened Cedar Park Dental in 2011 after a decade in a high-volume practice where she never had more than fifteen minutes with a patient. The whole point of this office is that you get longer than that.

staff.name: Dr. Anh Nguyen, DDS
staff.bio: University of Texas School of Dentistry. Fifteen years in general and cosmetic practice.

staff.name: Bethany Cole, RDH
staff.bio: Has been with the practice since it opened and knows most patients by name.
